name: Esper Sentinel
oracle_text: Whenever an opponent casts their first noncreature spell each turn, draw a card unless that player pays {X}, where X is this creature's power.
blocked_sentences: Whenever an opponent casts their first noncreature spell each turn, draw a card unless that player pays {X}, where X is this creature's power.

needs.what: a per-player once-each-turn restriction on a trigger -- say `max_per_turn_per_player: 1` on TriggerSpec (src/automtg/cards/schema.py:241), counted in `triggers._queue` under a key of `(obj.oid, ability.index, actor_pid)` instead of `(obj.oid, ability.index)`, where `actor_pid` is the seat the event was about (`event.player`, the same seat `_actor` already computes for the `controller: "you"/"opponent"` check and that `bindings["event_player"]` exposes). With it, Esper Sentinel is one `spell_cast` trigger: `controller: "opponent"`, `filter: {"not_types": ["Creature"]}`, `max_per_turn_per_player: 1`. It is the clause the whole Rhystic/tax family is printed with -- Rhystic Study is "whenever an opponent casts a spell" with no cap, but Esper Sentinel, Archivist of Oghma-likes and every "the first <X> an opponent does each turn" line need exactly this key
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `max_per_turn` exists and is documented as a *per-permanent* cap: `triggers._queue` (src/automtg/engine/triggers.py:1164) keys `state.triggers_this_turn` by `(obj.oid, ability.index)`, so `max_per_turn: 1` means "the first noncreature spell **any** opponent casts each turn". In a duel that coincides with the printed card; at a pod it silently eats the tax on every opponent after the first, which is where this card is actually played -- so it is an approximation, not the line. The three near substitutes each fail differently: (1) `nth`, the ordinal filter that would say "their first", is restricted to draw triggers at src/automtg/cards/loader.py:2226 (`'nth' only means anything on a draw trigger`) because only `draw_cards` stamps `data["nth"]` on its event; `game._cast` fires SPELL_CAST (src/automtg/engine/game.py:623) with player/source/oid/sid/card/kicked and no ordinal. (2) A `condition` on `{"cmp": [{"spells_cast_this_turn": {"binding": "event_player"}}, ...]}` counts the wrong things twice over: `TurnLedger.spells_cast` (src/automtg/engine/structs.py:798) is a flat per-player tally of **all** spells with no type filter, so an opponent who casts a creature first and an artifact second is at 2 and the tax never applies, while the printed card taxes that artifact; and 603.4 re-checks an intervening-if at resolution, the failure already recorded on `nth`. (3) The turn-flag route is not per player either: `set_turn_flag`/`has_turn_flag` write and read `TurnLedger.object_flags` keyed by the ability's own `ctx.source_oid` (src/automtg/engine/effects/conditions.py:220), i.e. by the Sentinel, so it reproduces `max_per_turn: 1` exactly. Nothing in `condition_keys`, `value_keys` or the trigger spec can ask "is this the first noncreature spell **this** player has cast this turn".

notes: Only the ordinal restriction is missing; the rest of the sentence is expressible today and was deliberately not written as a partial answer. "An opponent casts ... a noncreature spell" is a `spell_cast` trigger with `controller: "opponent"` and `filter: {"not_types": ["Creature"]}`. "draw a card unless that player pays {X}, where X is this creature's power" is the Flusterstorm/Daze shape the repo already uses -- a `may` op with `player: {"binding": "event_player"}` (SPELL_CAST fires with `player=pid`, the caster, so `event_player` is exactly "that player"), `pay: {"mana": "{1}", "times": {"power_of": {"self": true}}}` (op_may scales the mana half by the value expression at src/automtg/engine/effects/ops_control.py, validated at src/automtg/cards/loader.py:3990, so {1} times power is the printed {X}), empty `effects` and `else: [{"op": "draw", ...}]`.
